slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
乾国。
盐城。
宋文捧着从泔水桶中翻出来的两个糠馍，欣喜若狂。
糠馍中的谷糠很粗糙，清晰可辨。所幸，这个泔水桶中汤水不多，糠馍并没有被汤水浸透，还算干净，没有沾染到太多的汤水污渍。
他扒拉下糠馍上沾着的两片菜叶，全然不顾一旁泔水桶中散发出的阵阵恶臭，大口大口的将糠馍塞入口中，
冰冷糙涩的糠馍没有水的搭配，吞咽起来异常困难。宋文却是顾不得那么多，几口就将一个糠馍塞入了口中。
干涩的糠馍顶在喉咙上面，难以咽下，令他差点背过气去。
好不容易将糠馍吞下，让他饥肠辘辘的腹中略微好受一点，但依旧是毫无饱腹感。
他肉身穿越到这个世界已经两日了，这是他吃的第一顿饭。
当他缓过神来，看到一名十岁的乞丐小男孩出现在眼前，小乞丐正可怜巴巴的盯着他手中剩余的另一个糠馍，眼中充满了渴望和希冀。
宋文看了看眼前瘦弱的小乞丐，又看了看手中的糠馍。
在短暂的犹豫和纠结之后，他将糠馍送向了口中，并没有打算将糠馍分给小乞丐。
他穿越到这个类似于古代的世界，发现自己在现代社会所学所用的东西，根本派不上用场，自己生存都变得困难无比，哪有心思去可怜素不相识的旁人。
眼见糠馍就要进入宋文的大口之中，小乞丐脸色突然变得凶厉起来。
小乞丐突然猛地快跑两步，然后陡然跃起，一蹦两尺高，双手直接抓向了宋文手中的糠馍。
同时，小乞丐张开他那脏兮兮的嘴，露出焦黄的牙齿，一口朝宋文的小臂咬下。
对于小乞丐突然的暴起，宋文眼中先是闪过一丝慌乱，随即就变得暴怒起来。
自己本来在现代社会活得好好的，虽然不是什么成功人士，但也不愁吃喝。莫名其妙穿越到这处世界，几乎没有任何谋生的能力，心中本就窝火，
现在就连一个半大小乞丐都敢来欺负自己！
心中的怒火好似找到了一个宣泄口，

宋文的神情变得凶恶起来。
“滚！”
宋文挥动着手臂便朝小乞丐砸去。
宋文穿越到这处世界时，原本三十岁的身体变成了十四五岁模样，并不显得高大，但比起长期缺少食物的小乞丐来说，还是要高大强壮不少。
宋文的小臂直接砸在了小乞丐的脸上，小乞丐顿时鼻血喷溅。
但宋文显然是小瞧了小乞丐的狠厉程度，小乞丐并没有被宋文的小臂砸飞，反而是顺势抱住了宋文的手臂，一口就咬了上去。
在这整个过程之中，小乞丐脸上凶厉的表情始终没有丝毫变化，眼神从头至尾都死死盯在糠馍之上。
宋文吃痛，脸色变得越加凶狠。
“你这小畜生，竟敢咬我，老子打死你。”
宋文抬起膝盖，使出全身力气，狠狠的顶在了小乞丐的胸口处。
小乞丐遭受重击，身体发软，再抱不住宋文的小臂，整个身体朝后飞去，直接砸在了半丈外污浊的地面上。
心中暴怒的宋文并没有打算就此放过小乞丐，他上前两脚直接踢在了小乞丐的胸口，又将小乞丐的身体踢出了一丈开外，使其口中溢出鲜血，显然是受了内伤，这才作罢。
宋文正欲转身离去之时，愕然发现，小乞丐正目光怨毒的看着自己。
小乞丐目光让他遍体生寒，一丝不好的感觉爬上心尖。
自己初来乍到，在没有任何实力和背景之前，最好是不要得罪任何人，哪怕是一名社会最底层的小乞丐。
谁知道这小乞丐背后有没有当地黑恶势力庇护？
宋文目光与小乞丐对视良久，永绝后患的思绪闪过心头，
他俩现在所处的位置是个狭窄阴暗巷子，平时没什么人来，现在就他们两人在此，宋文相信，自己狠下心来，将小乞丐残忍杀害，一时半会也不会有人发现。
即使有人发现，一个小乞丐的死亡也引不起什么关注。
content_en:
Qianguo.
Yancheng.
Song Wen was ecstatic as he held the two rice bran buns he pulled out of the swill bucket.
The chaff in the bran buns is very rough and clearly identifiable. Fortunately, there wasn't much soup in the swill bucket, so the glutinous rice buns were not soaked by the soup and were relatively clean without being stained by too many soup stains.
He pulled off the two vegetable leaves stuck to the steamed bun, completely ignoring the stench emanating from the swill bucket beside him, and stuffed the steamed bun into his mouth with big mouthfuls.
The cold and rough rice cakes are extremely difficult to swallow without water. Song Wen didn't care so much and stuffed a steamed bun into his mouth after a few mouthfuls.
The dry glutinous rice buns stuck to the top of his throat, making it difficult to swallow and he almost lost his breath.
After finally swallowing the glutinous rice buns, his hungry stomach felt slightly better, but he still didn't feel full.
It had been two days since he physically traveled to this world, and this was the first meal he had eaten.
When he came to his senses, he saw a ten-year-old beggar boy appearing in front of him. The little beggar was staring pitifully at the other remaining bun in his hand, his eyes full of longing and hope.
Song Wen looked at the thin little beggar in front of him, and then at the bun in his hand.
After a brief hesitation and entanglement, he put the steamed bun into his mouth without intending to give it to the little beggar.
He traveled to this world similar to ancient times, and found that what he had learned and used in modern society was of no use at all. It became extremely difficult for him to survive, and he had no intention of pitying others he had never met.
Seeing that the rice cake was about to enter Song Wen's mouth, the little beggar's face suddenly became fierce.
The little beggar suddenly ran two steps quickly, then suddenly jumped up, jumping two feet high, and grabbed the rice cake in Song Wen's hand with both hands.
At the same time, the little beggar opened his dirty mouth, exposed his scorched yellow teeth, and bit down on Song Wen's forearm.
Regarding the sudden outburst of the little beggar, Song Wen's eyes first flashed with panic, and then he became furious.
I originally lived a good life in modern society. Although I was not a successful person, I didn't have to worry about food and drink. I was transported to this world inexplicably, with almost no ability to make a living, and I was already feeling angry.
Now even a half-sized beggar dares to bully him!
The anger in my heart seemed to have found an outlet,
Song Wen's expression became fierce.
"Get out!"
Song Wen waved his arm and hit the little beggar.
When Song Wen traveled to this world, his body of thirty years old turned into that of fourteen or fifteen years old. He did not look tall, but he was still much taller and stronger than a little beggar who had been short of food for a long time.
Song Wen's forearm hit the little beggar directly in the face, causing the little beggar's nose to bleed immediately.
But Song Wen obviously underestimated the ruthlessness of the little beggar. The little beggar was not knocked away by Song Wen's forearm. Instead, he hugged Song Wen's arm and bit him in one bite.
During the whole process, the fierce expression on the little beggar's face never changed at all, and his eyes were fixed on the glutinous rice bun from the beginning to the end.
Song Wen was in pain and his face became more and more fierce.
"You little beast, if you dare to bite me, I will beat you to death."
Song Wen raised his knees and used all his strength to hit the little beggar's chest hard.
The little beggar suffered a heavy blow and his body became weak. He could no longer hold Song Wen's forearm. His whole body flew backward and hit the dirty ground half a foot away.
Song Wen, who was furious in his heart, had no intention of letting the little beggar go. He stepped forward and kicked the little beggar directly in the chest, and then kicked the little beggar's body a foot away, causing blood to flow from his mouth. It was obvious that he had suffered internal injuries before he gave up.
When Song Wenzheng was about to turn around and leave, he was shocked to find that the little beggar was looking at him with malicious eyes.
The little beggar's gaze made him feel cold all over, and a bad feeling crept into his heart.
I have just arrived, and I don’t have any strength or backing.Before the scene, it is best not to offend anyone, even a beggar at the bottom of society.
Who knows if this little beggar is protected by local evil forces?
Song Wen looked at the little beggar for a long time, and the thought of never causing future troubles flashed through his mind.
The location they were in now was a narrow and dark alley. No one usually came here, but now they were the only two here. Song Wen believed that no one would notice him for a while if he was cruel enough to kill the little beggar.
Even if someone discovered it, the death of a little beggar would attract little attention.
